⚠️ **This type is _unstable_ and may change significantly in a way that the data won't be backwards compatible.**
A view for audio streams and assets.

Displays per-entity transport state, static codec metadata (codec,
sample rate, channel count), and diagnostic signals (gaps,
discontinuities, out-of-order segments) for the audio pipeline.

Playback follows the viewer's timeline — the view does not own its
own clock.
